about: The OrcaSlicer 2.4.2 WebAssembly engine, single-threaded build, from OrcaWeb's releases. Pinned: later OrcaWeb releases changed the engine's API (orc_* -> onewasm_*/oneslicer_*) and the newest need cross-origin isolation, which GitHub Pages can't provide. slicer/fetch-engine.sh downloads these exact files into web/slicer/engine/ and checks them.
